text:
rhea: quick convo on GA vs GA+1 scope for Dedicated burst. customers want predictable SLAs for tail latency while still getting burst headroom. need to pick a policy today. :mag_right:
dev: infra constraints - we can do pool-level soft-burst and priority lanes quickly. per-tenant guaranteed headroom needs quota bookkeeping and billing hooks which is heavier.
nok: runtime note - main risk is KV-cache cold starts on spillover. without a prewarm path, a tenant that spills will see 95p latency jump for several minutes.
elena: sales feedback - Fortune customers asked for a "tiered SLO" option: Bronze (best-effort burst), Silver (measured burst credits), Gold (reserved headroom + SLA). they'd sign enterprise deals for Gold.
carl: CS: need an easy opt-in for Silver pilots and a clear escalation playbook for Gold requests during launches. also want standard messaging for Bronze customers so they don't assume guarantees.
rhea: proposal - GA toggles: enable Bronze pool-level soft-burst (3x) + priority lanes; Silver = opt-in pilot flag with small burst credits (tokens/hr) and manual request flow; Gold = reserved headroom add-on (paid). gate GA on Bronze + telemetry + opt-in flow.
dev: sample autoscale / burst defaults we can ship:
```yaml
autoscale:
  scale_up_factor: 1.4
  scale_down_cooldown_s: 900
burst:
  pool_soft_multiplier: 3
  pilot_credits_per_hr: 50000
```
nok: recommend safety rules: (1) circuit-breaker: if 95p > 2x baseline for 5m, reduce pool multiplier to 1.2 and route opportunistic jobs to pinned lanes; (2) prewarm window: only allow opportunistic spill for first 3 minutes after scale event to avoid long tail KV warm.
elena: contract language draft: "Bronze burst is best-effort and not SLA-backed. Silver pilots have measured credits but are not guaranteed. Gold customers may purchase reserved headroom with SLA." i'll send to legal.
ops-bot: ticket CREATED: PROD-7122 "Dedicated: GA burst defaults + Silver pilot flow" assigned to @dev
dev: timeline: Bronze + telemetry + opt-in flow: 1 sprint. Silver pilot bookkeeping + billing hooks: GA+1 (2 sprints). Gold onboarding is sales/legal work but infra needs reservation API: GA+2.
rhea: decision: ship Bronze for GA with opt-in Silver pilot (manual), defer Silver auto-billing and Gold reservation APIs to GA+1/GA+2. owners: dev (infra), nok (runtime), elena (sales), carl (CS). all thumbs?
nok: thumbs up.
elena: thumbs up.
carl: thumbs up, will prepare pilot runbook.
rhea: will update roadmap and publish customer FAQ. follow-up sync 4pm PT. :calendar:
